notes: Address. The prefatory note says: 'These Addresses are not to be regarded as exhaustive, but suggestive.' (1884) No text is stated. Opening words: “The next element in prayer that I notice is Petition. How often we go to prayer-meetings without really asking for anything! Our prayers go all round the world, without anything …”
